options.name: The Nightingale
options.tradeoff: Some readers may find the historical context challenging to follow
options.concern: Length might be daunting for some members

options.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

options.tradeoff: Some readers might find the sci-fi elements confusing or off-putting
options.concern: Tone can be inconsistent, potentially alienating some readers
options.best_for: Fans of comedy and science fiction looking for a lighthearted read

options.name: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
options.upside: Engaging story with well-developed characters and themes
options.tradeoff: Some readers may find the pacing a bit slow or the subject matter heavy
options.concern: Length could be an issue for those preferring shorter books
options.best_for: Readers who enjoy character-driven stories, romance, and contemporary fiction

options.name: The Name of the Rose
options.upside: Intellectually stimulating with a complex, intriguing plot
options.tradeoff: The dense, philosophical content may deter some readers
options.concern: Length and complexity could be overwhelming for many club members
options.best_for: Those interested in historical mysteries, philosophy, and detailed storytelling
